item.tib: 'jig byed chen po 'chi bdag gshin rje khros nag khams gsum rgyal po'i zlog 'khor byad ma 'bum sgrol
item.coloph: 'jigs byed gshin rje brnag pa'i drwa ba la/ nyer mkho zab mo gnad kyis (kyi) man ngag 'di/ rang khengs rtog ge'i dri mas rab dben kyang*/ mtshungs med bstan pa'i gsal sgon rin po che/ gsang sngags grags pa'i bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ phas rgol bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyir/ gsang ba'i rnal 'byor kun grol grags pa yis/ lhun grub dpag bsam ljon pa'i gling du bgyis/ 'dis kyang g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyan gyur cing / dgos 'dod phrin las thog(thogs) med 'grub 'gyur cig/
